nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL)
nodes.rationale: Preamble states the OFL's goals: stimulate worldwide development of collaborative font projects, support font creation efforts of academic and linguistic communities, and provide a free/open framework for sharing and improving fonts, while prohibiting standalone sale of the fonts and prohibiting relicensing of the Font Software under any other license (documents created with the fonts are exempt).
